facility.name: Allegro Childrens Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 4019 MONTANA AVE, EL PASO, TX, 79903

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Available in Each Building, on Field Trips, during Transportation: A fully equipped first aid kit was not available at the operation during inspection. The first aid kit was missing a thermometer, scissors, and antiseptic wipes or solution.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Available in Each Building, on Field Trips, during Transportation (26 TAC §746.4001)

occurrences.finding: 746.5533 carbon monoxide detection system installed: A carbon monoxide detection system could not be located during inspection.    This was corrected when a battery operated carbon monoxide detector was found in the office. New batteries were installed and a notation on Fire Safey Practices Form 7263 was added for monthly checking and servicing of carbon monoxide system.
occurrences.violation_type_title: 746.5533 carbon monoxide detection system installed (26 TAC §746.5533)

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: During DFPS investigation it was determined a caregiver(s) counted in ratio were on their personal cell phones while caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: Vehicle used to transport children in care from school to the operation was missing a fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: Vehicle used to transport children in care from school to operation was missing a first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Information About Facility: Vehicle used to transport children from school to operation did not have information about the operation either in the glove compartment, in the passenger compartment or on the outside of the vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Information About Facility (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Annual fire inspection has not been completed. Last fire inspection was conducted September 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: Director's CPR training expired in November 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age: During walk through of operation Inspectors observed an 11-month-old and 12- month-old children in the toddler room because there was no infant room set up.  The 11-month-old infant is non walking and did not have a crib. Photos taken and uploaded to operation's digital storage.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2405(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: During evaluation of records, three caregiver files were missing eight hours of pre-service training and the notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: The outdoor play area had two pogo sticks, stilts and a shopping cart that can cause injury to children in care. Corrected during the inspection, the pogo sticks, stilts and shopping cart were removed from the outdoor play area and placed in an area out of the reach of children. Photos taken and uploaded to operation's digital storage.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The outdoor playground area has aluminum siding that is rusted with sharp edges. There is a hazard of children cutting themselves on the sharp edges. Photos taken and uploaded to operation's digital storage.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: During walk through of the toddler room, a 55-inch television was not properly anchored/secured.     The person in charge of the operation removed the television from the toddler room and placed it in a storage area that was out of children's reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: The outdoor playground structure bridge was cracked. The crack on the bridge has an exposed sharp edge that could be hazardous to children. Photos were taken and uploaded to operation's digital storage.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Operation did not have files available for review for an 11-month-old infant and a 12-month-old infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: The operation was missing four required lock-down drills for 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The operation had a urinal in the boy's bathroom that was not operational and in need of repair.  Person in charge stated the urinal has not been operational for the past six months. Photo taken and uploaded to operation's digital storage.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The minibus used for transportation contained a fire extinguisher with an expired service tag dated March 2022. This poses a hazard to children because if a fire was to start on the minivan it could not be extinguished.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Age Range of Children In Care: Operation failed to notify Licensing that they added infant care services. Person in charge stated they have been providing infant care since November 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Age Range of Children In Care (26 TAC §746.301(5))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The outdoor playground has a loose sand fill surface less than six inches. Photos taken and uploaded to operation's digital storage.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: During review of records, a pre-school child was missing a written statement from a health-care professional indicating the child is able to take part in the child-care program.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely: Six windows on minibus used for children transportation do not open. The minibus child alarm system is not in operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: The operation has a structure with a slide in the toddler room. The slide was observed cracked with clear tape however slide should not be used because the taped area is a weak spot. The legs of the structure were loos and not screwed in. Corrected during inspection.  Entire structure was removed from the toddler room and placed in a storage close out of reach of children. Photos were taken and uploaded to operation's digital storage.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The minibus used for transporting children contained an incomplete first aid kit. The kit contained expired multi-sized adhesive bandages. The kit contained loose disposable gloves deeming them unsterilized.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation was missing monthly fire drills for December 2022 and January 2023. Corrected during the inspection a monthly fire drill was observed and documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center: During inspection there were two classrooms that did not have daily schedules posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(5))

occurrences.finding: HRC42.054 - Required Fees: The annual fees were due 2/16/22 and had not been paid.    The director paid the amount due at time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC42.054 - Required Fees (26 TAC §HRC42.054 - Required Fees)

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: Upon review of people list there were two individuals who have no longer been working at the center and had not been inactivated within 7 days of leaving the center.     This was corrected when the director inactivated the individuals in the CCR account during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))
